summary: Comprehensive Phase 2 domain analysis and design document for the BCSMS system. Covers all 16 analysis questions: core entities, value objects, enums, aggregate boundaries and roots, user modeling strategy (single entity with role enum recommended), ServiceRequest lifecycle state machine, business invariants, department/employee assignment flow, WorkOrder analysis (deferred from MVP), SLA placement, AuditLog placement, Notification placement, Attachment modeling, geographic location modeling, and MVP scope decisions. Includes Mermaid ER diagram, state transition diagram, entity/VO/enum lists, key business rules, and deferred features list. Awaiting user approval before code implementation.
